text:
Sam K.: :memo: quick reminder — we're cutting the release at 3pm PT today. Please add a one-line release note for any merged PRs. Use the release notes template and tag component. Small edits only, no new features unless urgent.
Maria L.: where's the template? also — do we bump minor or patch for this?
Sam K.: Template: https://go/release-notes-template or paste below. This is a patch release — bump PATCH (x.y.Z -> x.y.Z+1). If your PR changes behavior, please call it out.
Alicia G.: :clock3: cutoff is 3pm PT, i'm coordinating the rollup at 3:15. will ping when I start the compile.
Ojas P.: if you need a backport, ping me here. branch naming: `release/<version>` please.
Sam K.: snippet to copy: ```- summary: Short one-liner
  component: infra|runtime|api|docs
  pr: #1234```
Maria L.: adding one now: `- summary: Fix changelog rendering for long lines; component: docs; pr: #4512` :thumbsup:
release-bot: deploycheck: release-preflight passed on cluster-prod-2 :white_check_mark:
Alicia G.: heads-up — if your note is >4 lines i'll ask for a condensed one. keep it tight so the release notes stay scannable.
Ojas P.: quick q — do we include model-version bumps in notes (e.g., model v2.1 -> v2.2 quantized)?
Sam K.: yes, include model bumps. one line summary + impact (latency/cost) if it's user-facing. e.g., `Model: upgraded to llama-2-13b-q4f -> ~+5% latency, -20% cost`
Maria L.: done & linked the PR in the one-liner. thanks for the nudge.
Sam K.: thanks all — i'll collate entries at 3:10 and open the final changelog PR. ping here if you need me to rephrase anything. :shipit:
